_sources._note: The pricing page renders its tables with JavaScript and sets its worked S3 Tables example in US West (Oregon), so the US East (N. Virginia) figures were read from AWS's Price List offer file. Where the page's worked examples print the same figure, both are cited. List prices only: no Free Tier, taxes, data transfer or engine charges.

storage_gb_month.unit: GB-month, S3 Tables Standard, cumulative tiers

tiers.quote: $0.0265 per GB-Mo for First 50 TB of Storage in S3 Table Buckets
$0.0253 per GB-Mo for Next 450 TB of Storage in S3 Table Buckets
$0.0242 per GB-Mo for Over 500 TB of Storage in S3 Table Buckets

put_per_1000_requests.quote: $0.005 per 1,000 PUT Requests/COPY/POST or LIST Requests to S3 Table Buckets

get_per_1000_requests.quote: $0.0004 per 1,000 GET and All Other Requests to S3 Table Buckets

monitoring_per_1000_objects.quote: $0.025 per 1,000 objects per month monitoring fee

compaction_binpack_per_1000_objects.quote: $0.002 per 1,000 objects compacted in S3 Table Buckets

compaction_binpack_per_gb.quote: $0.005 per GB fee for bytes processed for compaction

compaction_sort_per_1000_objects.quote: $0.002 per 1,000 objects compacted with sort or Z-order

compaction_sort_per_gb.quote: $0.01 per GB fee for bytes processed for sort or Z-order compaction

compaction_zorder_per_1000_objects.quote: $0.002 per 1,000 objects compacted with sort or Z-order

compaction_zorder_per_gb.quote: $0.01 per GB fee for bytes processed for sort or Z-order compaction

replication_per_1000_table_updates.quote: $0.01 per 1,000 table updates for tables replicated in S3 table buckets

metadata_journal_per_million_updates.quote: $0.30 per 1 million updates processed for S3 Metadata
